description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking

description.name: Awoken Guiding Guardian
description.text: Samurai abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Blade of Allegiance after using a Samurai ability

description.name: Readied Blade Mode
description.text: Cast speed x2.00, Samurai abilities deal 10/20/30% more damage after using 0/1/2+ Samurai abilities
